INSERT INTO applications
  (ref_token, lead_id, unit_id, full_name, email, phone, ssn_last4,
   current_address, prior_address, desired_move_in, employer_name, job_title,
   claimed_monthly_income, rental_assistance_amount, occupants, pets, vehicles,
   disclosures, fcra_consent_at, status)
VALUES
  ($1, (SELECT id FROM leads WHERE ref_token = NULLIF($2::text,'')),
   $3::int,
   $4, $5, NULLIF($6::text,''), NULLIF($7::text,''),
   NULLIF($8::text,''), NULLIF($9::text,''), NULLIF($10::text,'')::date,
   NULLIF($11::text,''), NULLIF($12::text,''),
   NULLIF($13::text,'')::numeric, NULLIF($14::text,'')::numeric,

   jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('description', $16)),

RETURNING *;

options.instructions:
Extract figures from a pay stub. Report only what is printed on the document.

Never estimate, never infer, never annualise, and never fill in a plausible value.
If a field is not printed on the document, return null for it.

gross_this_period is the gross for THIS pay period only. Do not return the year-to-date
column. If both appear, take the 'this period' one.

For every figure you report, add the verbatim line you read it from to source_quotes, so a
human can check the value against the document.

Do not record anything about the person beyond their name as printed. Do not output any
judgement, assessment, score, or recommendation about the applicant.

UPDATE applications SET
  extracted_monthly_income = NULLIF($2::text,'')::numeric,
  extraction_evidence = $3::jsonb,
  verified_monthly_income = NULLIF($4::text,'')::numeric,
  plaid_raw = $5::jsonb,
  plaid_verified_at = now(),
  income_comparison = $6::jsonb,
  bureau_source = 'mock',
  credit_score = NULLIF($7::text,'')::int,
  eviction_filings = NULLIF($8::text,'')::int,
  bureau_raw = $9::jsonb,
  identity_source = 'mock',
  identity_match = TRUE,
  identity_confidence = NULLIF($10::text,'')::numeric,
  criteria_result = $11,
  criteria_evidence = $12::jsonb,
  criteria_evaluated_at = now(),
  status = 'awaiting_decision'
WHERE ref_token = $1 RETURNING *;
